husbandry_expansion.stage: 1.1.6: fix live trashcan resolution, concise labels/direct feed rows, native-body scrolling with original/add-on messages preserved.
husbandry_expansion.priority: Reduce extremely repetitive daily operation before adding production complexity.
husbandry_expansion.user_reported_pain: Rat meat production needs genetics, sterilization, disease and crowding management; fish need repeated feed preparation. Effort and return compare poorly with blind boxes and pure water.
husbandry_expansion.cattle_and_pigs: Use native rat husbandry/growth framework for cattle and pigs; both sexes are omnivorous. Adults may be kept for recurring products or sold; elderly animals can be slaughtered through the native butcher.
husbandry_expansion.future_merchant_stock: Seeds, calves, piglets and added fish species.
husbandry_expansion.automation_boundary: Native feeding, keepers/slaughter and hopper transport. Optional feces-to-trash defaults ON: no robot clears cage; same-cage robot only near full. Automatic green serum defaults OFF.
husbandry_expansion.sales_channel: Confirmed: calves and piglets are fattened to adulthood, then placed on the counter and sold to ordinary customers. No automatic sale.
husbandry_expansion.economic_review: Assess net income per space-day, capital payback time and player operations per week; do not set price multipliers before testing costs and production.
husbandry_expansion.equipment_and_feed_sources: Confirmed: reuse and expand the native animal cage for cattle/pigs. Automatic feeding searches edible items in the main inventory and warehouse.
husbandry_expansion.housing: Reuse/expand native AnimalCage; no new separate barn device.
husbandry_expansion.feed_sources: Native dispenser/hopper supply. The mod no longer consumes arbitrary warehouse food.
husbandry_expansion.feed_priority: Native rules and player-configured equipment; old automatic lowest-price selection removed.
husbandry_expansion.maintenance_scope: No mod automatic cage repair, water top-up or filter replacement in 1.1.4. Player/native devices handle supplies.

cage_repair.trigger: Below configurable threshold X; percentage/default to be specified
cage_repair.no_resource: Do not repair without stock; show supply status
cage_repair.scope: Cage durability repair, not animal disease treatment

husbandry_expansion.fish_pain: Rapid breeding raises feeding requirements and fills RAS space; the user reports fish cannot be generated when crowded. Feed supply and safe crowded-tank growth are priority pain points.
husbandry_expansion.fish_control: Native breeding; old mod switches and 32-stock cap are inactive. No existing stock is deleted by retired controls.
husbandry_expansion.fish_conversion_proposal: Proposed priority fix: verify capacity before converting roe/fry; retain original stock and metadata if conversion cannot complete. This is independent of the player-controlled breeding policy.
husbandry_expansion.feed_supply: Superseded by weekly stock design: Wednesday retains seeds and has a 50% supplementary feed/food chance; Saturday guarantees food/feed and young livestock/fertilized roe. Saturday exact quantities/species remain to be finalized.
husbandry_expansion.management_ui: No management page. User explicitly authorized vertical scrolling in the existing native night report to show all original/add-on entries.

layouts: Report and management subpages inside the same Night Report panel
management_ui_proposal.recommended_layout: Subpages, retaining the existing Calendar/Night Report/Status navigation
management_ui_proposal.settings_scope: Proposed per-device settings; feeding and maintenance toggles, fish breeding switch/cap, cage repair threshold and ingredient exclusions
management_ui_proposal.timing: Proposed: changes affect the next nightly settlement, not the already completed report
management_ui_proposal.population_accounting: Proposed: adult stock plus projected fry/fertilized roe count; retain existing offspring and manual disease treatment/harvest
management_ui_proposal.report_contents: Actual consumed feed, scrap/water/filter upkeep, breeding pauses, stock waiting for space, missing supplies
management_ui_proposal.mockup_values: Illustrative only; mockup population 18 and threshold 50% are not approved balance values

weekly_merchant_stock.stage: Design for husbandry release; not applied to installed 1.0.2

wednesday.seeds: Retain existing added seed sales and progression gates
wednesday.roll_interpretation: Proposed: one whole-bundle roll per Wednesday visit, stored with that visit so loading does not reroll.
wednesday.ability_filter: Planned interpretation: retain farming day eligibility; the one-time bonus roll stays fixed, but fish-only feed is offered only with aquaculture unlocked.
wednesday.feed_upgrade_interpretation: Proposed shared rule: Aquaculture II raises each feed to 2 in both an awarded Wednesday supplement and Saturday guaranteed stock; Small Nutrifruit stays at 3.

saturday.quantities: Confirmed: juvenile rats 2 (1 male + 1 female); calves 2 (1 male + 1 female); piglets 2 (1 male + 1 female); fertilized Tilapia/Graft Tilapia/Gutter Tilapia roe one unit of each; future added fish roe one per species, species TBD; Eel/Electric Eel/Sturgeon one each with Aquaculture II; gutterflow pellets and industrial fish feed one each initially, two each with Aquaculture II.

meat_supplement.decision: Confirmed: sell a small supplementary quantity of meat on Saturday
meat_supplement.proposal_status: Suggested baseline, quantity not explicitly confirmed
meat_supplement.purpose: Emergency early-game supplement; not enough to replace purchased feed for a growing farm

weekly_merchant_stock.compatibility: Keep per-visit persisted inventory and pending-counter behavior; no rerolls or restocking from repeated loading.

progression_requirements.visit_policy: No corresponding production ability means no corresponding stock and no visit just for that stock. Skip all visits if no relevant production ability is unlocked.
progression_requirements.wednesday: Only when farming/hydroponic ability is unlocked, including the Hydroponic Farmer start. Other starts wait until they unlock it.
progression_requirements.saturday: Animal husbandry and aquaculture stock unlock independently with their corresponding abilities/start conditions. Rat Breeder and Aquaculture starts gain their respective extension content.
progression_requirements.aquaculture_base: Fish culture requires explicit aquaculture/water-related ability/talent unlock; owning a tank alone is insufficient.
progression_requirements.aquaculture_II: Gates one each of Eel, Electric Eel and Sturgeon; raises gutterflow pellets and industrial feed to two each.
progression_requirements.unresolved_native_mapping: Resolved: farming uses native RETIRED_FARMER; mammal husbandry uses RETIRED_RANCHER; aquaculture uses AQUACULTURE / AQUACULTURE_II. FARMER, RANCHER and AQUAFARMER starts unlock the matching native ability during initialization.

native_checks.water_merchant: WATER_TRADER is a separate native unlock, not an implicit aquaculture unlock

progression_requirements.merchant_visit_matrix: Wednesday requires farming; Saturday requires mammals or aquaculture. Filter Saturday mammal/aquaculture stock independently. With no relevant unlocked ability, do not queue the merchant. Unlocking an ability later enables its group for any starting class.
progression_requirements.ancient_seed_gift: Proposed consequence of the content gate: the merchant ancient-seed gift also requires farming availability; preserve existing actual-visit and obtained/delivered records.

next_design_checks: In-engine acceptance: complete overnight and live save round trip, full product/tray/tank boundaries and report UI at target resolution.
Playtest feed costs, upkeep and pair-level space-day profit; use configurable stage ages and production intervals for tuning.
husbandry_expansion.projected_fish_count: Count fertilized roe and fry groups by their projected individual fish count. The three native tilapia variants each use groupCount=6, so one unit of each fertilized roe represents 18 future fish.
husbandry_expansion.carnivore_feed_decision: Confirmed B: retain native carnivorous-fish diet rules. Saturday merchant sells a small supplementary quantity of meat; industrial feed is not made universal.
husbandry_expansion.food_economy_goal: Early game still requires purchased food. Later, fish/livestock can be manually slaughtered and their meat can feed other compatible cultured species; create a cross-feeding production loop.
husbandry_expansion.slaughter_boundary: Supersedes the earlier manual-only limit: reuse and extend native MachineAutoButcher for suitable fish/cattle/pig slaughter. Preserve its age/weight rules and keeper protections. Sale still uses the existing counter/customer flow; no automatic cash sale was requested.

cross_feeding_design.confirmed_goal: Prepared meat from player-directed or native-automatic slaughter enters compatible cross-feeding loops, while early purchases remain relevant.
suggested_flow: Owned edible food, plants or meat -> omnivorous cattle/pigs/rats and eligible fish
Native automatic butcher meat output -> feed or counter sale
Fish meat and mammal meat -> other compatible cultured species
cross_feeding_design.cattle_diet: Confirmed B: cattle, pigs and rats all use omnivorous feeding rules.
cross_feeding_design.automatic_consumption: Prepared food and slaughter products from manual or native automatic slaughter; extension auto-feeding does not independently select and kill live stock.
cross_feeding_design.automatic_exclusions_proposed: Exclude live animals/fry/fertilized roe and meat carrying disease flags; avoid mammal same-species meat that triggers native cannibalism disease
cross_feeding_design.economy: Include growth time, space, water/power, upkeep, accumulated feeding and slaughter yields in the production balance

mammal_production.growth_framework: Native rat growth mechanisms remain confirmed. Earlier relative timing 1A (pigs faster than cattle) is now under balance review at the user request because pigs have recurring truffles plus luxury meat.

cow.adult_male: Continue growing until elderly, then lose weight
cow.elder_female: Stops milk production; eligible for meat slaughter
cow.period_and_yield: Confirmed 2A default: one milk every two days during the adult female production phase; production interval adjustable in mod settings.

pig.adult_either_sex: Superseded: recurring Small Black Truffle production is limited to adult males.
pig.elder_slaughter: Meat plus exactly one Standard Black Truffle per elderly pig, either sex, per the previously confirmed rule.
pig.period_and_yield: Confirmed default: adult male pigs produce one Small Black Truffle every three days; adult females do not produce it. Interval remains adjustable in mod settings.
pig.adult_male: Confirmed: produces Small Black Truffle at the configured interval; default one every three days.
pig.adult_female: Confirmed: does not produce recurring Small Black Truffles. Breeding, fattening, live sale and slaughter remain available.

mammal_production.collection: Confirmed 3A: milk and Small Black Truffle are automatically placed in a separate animal-cage product inventory during nightly processing; production pauses when that inventory is full and is reported in the Night Report.
mammal_production.butcher_compatibility: Extend native cut generation for new species and the elderly-pig truffle bonus; preserve normal rat handling

new_aquatic_species.growth_framework: Native FishSpecies/AquacultureHelper water, feeding and growth mechanisms
new_aquatic_species.roe_quantity: One fertilized-roe unit per added species, per earlier merchant rule
new_aquatic_species.diet_breeding_tier_yields: Diet, reproduction, unlock tiers and harvest forms confirmed. Sea-cucumber tapering growth and organic-waste-only cleanup now confirmed. Numeric growth, yields, values and new-item footprints remain pending.

lobster.role: Confirmed: slaughter yields dedicated high-value Lobster Meat, displayed as FOOD + LUXURY_ITEM; keep functional meat-feed classification.
lobster.merchant_roe: Earlier one-unit added-species fertilized-roe rule retained unless user revises acquisition

harvest.slaughter: Reuse native automatic butcher output flow with custom species yield

sea_cucumber.role: Confirmed: longer rearing raises whole-item food calories and nightly water remediation capacity. Harvest produces one intact sea cucumber, not separated fillets or meat pieces.
sea_cucumber.population_control: Subject to player-set tank breeding switch and population cap

harvest.slaughter: Native automatic butcher compatibility should output intact sea cucumber

growth_value.user_rule: Food calories and remediation capacity both increase with longer rearing
growth_value.native_basis: Native fish meat kcal uses consumed kcal times conversion efficiency; native remediation scales with weight.
growth_value.implementation_proposal: Healthy fed growth contributes nutrition; scale remediation with growth/rearing rather than fixed item value.
growth_value.growth_curve_and_limits: Confirmed 1A on 2026-11-05: during normal feeding, calories and organic-waste cleanup capacity increase with rearing time; later gains gradually taper. This choice does not specify numeric coefficients, a hard cap or final price.
growth_value.remediation_pollutants: Confirmed 2A on 2026-11-05: aquaculture organic_waste only. Do not remove heavy_metal, chemical_contaminant or physical_contaminant as part of the sea-cucumber effect.

confirmed_choices.growth: A: sustained growth with tapering later gains under normal feeding
confirmed_choices.source: Latest user message in continuation chat on 2026-11-05

growth_value.implementation_constraint: Use a species-scoped organic-waste cleanup path. Native AquacultureHelper.RunRemediation iterates heavy_metal, chemical_contaminant and physical_contaminant, not organic_waste; enabling that generic native remediation field alone would implement the wrong scope. Do not change the global native pollutant list.

husbandry_expansion.producer_handling_proposal: Consider native-butchery protection for actively producing cattle/pigs, with elder-stage slaughter; exact interaction with existing age/weight/keeper settings is still to be designed.
husbandry_expansion.creative_reference: User explicitly identifies cattle, pigs, milk, black truffles, lobsters and sea cucumbers as inspired by Stardew Valley. Native Probably Stolen animal/aquaculture mechanisms remain the confirmed mechanical framework; exact timing and whether to borrow other Stardew-specific behavior are not yet confirmed.

product_storage_rules.full: Pause production and show the reason in Night Report
product_storage_rules.previous_cycle_and_lost_items: Do not discard products because inventory is full
product_storage_rules.feeding_separation_proposed: Keep collected products outside the livestock feeding area; player can transfer them into eligible inventory for feeding or sale
product_storage_rules.milk_and_truffles: Milk: FOOD/BREVAGE. Small/Standard Black Truffle: FOOD/LUXURY_ITEM.

configuration_placement.mod_settings: User explicitly requests later adjustment of production intervals in mod settings. Defaults: milk 2 days, Small Black Truffle 3 days.
configuration_placement.night_report: Native messages append normally. NightReportScroll wraps the existing content group, supports wheel/drag and preferred text height; the themed frame/tabs/footer stay in place.
configuration_placement.growth_tempo: Relative pig/cattle tempo confirmed; numeric growth settings can be evaluated when assigning species stats.

husbandry_expansion.pig_cow_balance_concern: User questions the earlier pig-faster/cow-slower choice: recurring Small Black Truffle plus luxury-tagged large meat may make pigs too profitable, while milk has FOOD/BREVAGE categories.
husbandry_expansion.pig_cow_balance_review: Keep confirmed milk 2-day and Small Black Truffle 3-day intervals as configurable defaults. Evaluate revised maturity/adult windows, pair-level recurring output, final meat, feed/maintenance costs and space-day profit before finalizing growth.

growth_balance_proposal.status: Proposed response to user concern; not final approved numeric tuning
growth_balance_proposal.direction: Cows mature earlier and sustain milk production; pigs mature later with a shorter productive adult phase

pig.small_truffles_per_adult: Sex-dependent: 4 for an adult male, 0 for an adult female, under the proposed age 10-22 window.

growth_balance_proposal.counting: Count eligible adult nightly settlements from the first adult night; Elder stage stops recurring products. Values exclude disease/starvation/full-storage pauses and genetic/config changes.
growth_balance_proposal.economic_review: Compare whole-pair lifecycle revenue including terminal meat, then subtract juvenile purchase, feed, upkeep and time/space costs. Higher unit price should not produce overwhelmingly higher steady net profit.
growth_balance_proposal.target: Suggested: cattle offer earlier stable returns; pigs have high-value products with slower payback and only moderately higher steady profit.
growth_balance_proposal.latest_sex_rule: The male-only Small Black Truffle rule supersedes the earlier both-sex production comparison. Proposed growth ages remain a test proposal, not a confirmed final balance.

husbandry_expansion.production_sex_rules: Cow: recurring milk only from adult females. Pig: recurring Small Black Truffle only from adult males. Elder-pig slaughter Standard Black Truffle reward still applies to both sexes.

verified_local_game_facts.build: Local installed Assembly-CSharp.dll inspected read-only on 2026-11-05
verified_local_game_facts.native_seed_vendor_and_schedule_anchor: Native retired farmer remains StoreClientListSpec.CreateRetiredFarmer / retired_farmer on Friday. Added merchant now has an independent Wednesday/Saturday schedule.
verified_local_game_facts.perennial_behavior: Native perennials begin the next fruiting cycle after harvest while retaining the parent plant
verified_local_game_facts.seed_return: Harvest logic explicitly outputs seeds; PlantHarvest then applies SEED_YIELD and inherits parent traits
verified_local_game_facts.native_trait_inheritance: InheritTraits copies current ranks for all registered traits, including zero ranks, and clears temporary editing heat
verified_local_game_facts.native_perennial_penalties: Harvest quantity -25%, growth speed -20%, seed yield -50%; incompatible with infertile
verified_local_game_facts.native_seed_trait_compatibility: Fertile and infertile require a crop marked as returning seeds; multiplying zero base seed output cannot create seeds
verified_local_game_facts.custom_client_generation_hook: ModHook.OnGenerateCustomerVeryLate exposes StoreClientManager after native client generation; its clientStack is a List<StoreClient> consumed from index zero
verified_local_game_facts.native_merchant_departure_cleanup: PlayerStore.DismissCurrentClient invokes RemoveNotOwnedItemFromTable; unowned items on front and back counters are destroyed, while owned objects such as newspapers remain
verified_local_game_facts.station_scavenging_optional_compatibilit: Read-only review of local StationScavenging v1.5.2: ModEntry.ModId is station_scavenging. Lower rewards use dumpingGroundTG with station_scavenging.lower_service_crate. All five regions share a three-night precious cooldown. LowerScavenging currently calls RecordPreciousFind only for the service-crate item, so adding a seed requires explicit integration rather than assuming that a loot-table entry automatically participates in the cooldown.
verified_local_game_facts.note: v0.1.3 seed repair validated against the actual native compiled input predicate, including the prior rejection case and ownership/container rules. Same-size artwork comparison inspected. Live game remains on its loaded version until restart; no v0.1.3 in-game visual test has been performed.
verified_local_game_facts.native_seed_slot: Actual MachineHydroponic.SetupInputSlot predicate requires ownership, SEED tag and absence of CONTAINER_TAG. HydroponicHelper.InitSeedItem adds SEED_ITEM_TAG but does not add the SEED category/tag. Missing SEED was the insertion blocker; the single-slot native filter is independent of the exported texture pixel size.
verified_local_game_facts.native_sprite_restore: GameItem.SetSpriteAndShape does not clear useSpriteFromMod; clear it when a custom wine bottle is reset to native empty
verified_local_game_facts.native_ui_sprite_size: GameItemElement uses Image.SetNativeSize. PPU maps 128px/cell textures to native 16px/cell display size. Bind via public SetSprite plus explicit SetShape, avoiding shape inference from high-resolution pixels.
verified_local_game_facts.user_confirmed_0_1_4: User reported normal operation after crop hit-surface correction and downward portrait offset
verified_local_game_facts.native_seed_stack_split: Native GetSplitItem creates a factory item without the original seed instance state. Native TagSystem.Clone shares TagState objects. AutoPlant copies individual TagState values so the planted seed and remaining stack stay independent.
verified_local_game_facts.native_harvest_cleanup: ContinueGrowing finishes harvest and destroys annual seed before postfix replanting; perennial seeds remain in the input and are left alone
verified_local_game_facts.native_calendar: StoreCalendar.GetDayOfWeek uses dayCounter modulo 7: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday, 3 Wednesday, 6 Saturday.
verified_local_game_facts.husbandry_baseline: Installed build has AnimalSpecies.Rat, AnimalCage, MachineFeedDispenser automatic blending/target fullness, MachineAutoButcher with breeding-stock guards and fish roe collection, and extensible FishSpecies / AquacultureHelper. These are inspection findings, not new mod features.
verified_local_game_facts.native_cage_and_tank_maintenance: AnimalCage exposes durability via CAGE_HEALTH_TAG; native Repair consumes scrap metal and restores 50% of maximum durability. AquacultureHelper tracks organic waste and filtration. No separate cage hygiene meter was found in inspected cage code.
verified_local_game_facts.fish_group_conversion: Native AquacultureHelper.HatchRoe and GrowFry destroy the source roe/fry before attempting placement of generated fry/fish via GraphUtils.TryAcceptAllOrDestroy. A space-safe conversion path needs to retain source stock if placement cannot complete.
verified_local_game_facts.native_fish_feed_stock: Installed StoreClientListSpec aquaculture vendor offers two industrial_fish_feed items per visit. Native feed is 5000 kcal by default and base value kcal/50; industrial diet applies a growth-speed modifier.
verified_local_game_facts.native_crowded_fish_loss: GraphUtils.TryAcceptAllOrDestroy attempts placement, then destroys unplaced stock. HatchRoe/GrowFry consume original stock first, so lack of placement space can lose roe/fry-derived fish.
verified_local_game_facts.night_report_ui: AdvCalendarUIManager has nightlyReportSection, OnNightlyReportButtonClicked and OpenUIFromNightlyReport. StartOfDayUIManager.ShowMorningReport opens that panel and InitPanel displays PlayerStore.nightLogs.
verified_local_game_facts.start_unlock_mapping: Native NewGameData sets RETIRED_FARMER for FARMER, RETIRED_RANCHER for RANCHER, and AQUACULTURE for AQUAFARMER. WATER_MERCHANT sets WATER_TRADER separately.
verified_local_game_facts.slaughter_and_feed_baseline: Native meat_scrap is 350 kcal, base value 12. Native fish meat nutrition is derived from consumed kcal and species conversion efficiency; native rat cuts retain ANIMAL_RAT meat-origin and prion tags. Native same-species mammal meat can trigger prion disease.
verified_local_game_facts.rat_growth_and_butcher: Native rat stages are ages 0/1/3/5/11/14, with Adult at 5 and Elder at 11. Native MachineAutoButcher supports weight/age criteria, keeper sexes, protection flags, and output-space checks; HusbandryHelper.CreateButcherCuts currently returns cuts only for ANIMAL_RAT.
verified_local_game_facts.aquatic_harvest_paths: Native AquacultureHelper.CreateFilletPieces normally decomposes fish into meat items; native automatic butcher routes its returned items into tray/feed storage. Whole sea-cucumber output requires an explicit species-specific harvest path retaining nutrition.
verified_local_game_facts.native_aquatic_remediation_scope: Native AquacultureHelper.REMEDIATED_LIQUIDS contains heavy_metal, chemical_contaminant and physical_contaminant; organic_waste is not in that native biological-remediation list. Sea-cucumber waste cleanup scope must be specified separately.
verified_local_game_facts.sea_cucumber_cleanup_scope: Inspected native AquacultureHelper: organic_waste is the aquaculture waste liquid, while REMEDIATED_LIQUIDS contains only heavy_metal, chemical_contaminant and physical_contaminant. Organic-only cleanup needs a targeted extension.
